plan.name: Limit reader charts after complete projection
plan.summary: Apply the inclusive 500-state drawing limit to the complete partition by reader label and violated-invariant set, and admit complete explorations through 100,000 concrete states for locked-invariant replay and full view validation without shrinking bounds, sampling members or changing the advisory 20-arrow target; this is the complete first step of parent #943 and a two-way-door refinement of D-0343 and D-0345 recorded by this ratified plan under D-0421/#809. Pin inclusive work limits of 1,000,000 concrete step occurrences and 1,000,000 state/invariant cells, a 64 MiB compact-JSON projection-input budget including the all-false invariant-matrix reservation, a 64 MiB aggregate generated replay-module/configuration budget before replay, and a 60 MiB ceiling on every complete serialized or rendered evidence entry with 4 MiB headroom under the unchanged archive limit, using the counting rules, precedence, limitation discriminator and bounded companion contract in projection_944_accept_test.go. Carry exact projected, concrete and volume outcomes through proposals, alternatives, captured baselines and session reuse, comparisons, verification and synthesis receipts, ordinary and compact factory publication, saved drafts and dashboard validation, retaining independently fitting candidate/final evidence in fingerprint-bound fixed companions when a combined record cannot fit, never returning a partial chart or delta, and preserving source authority, fresh final checks, specific runtime diagnostics, cancellation, isolation, cleanup, all verification/ratification identities, historical concrete-500 limitations and historical comparison fingerprints. Before production edits, capture and commit the named ordinary, preview and comparison byte fixtures from the original base with its revision and reproducible inputs, then reconcile the explicitly scoped old 501/502-state tests and full-protocol fakes while keeping genuine projected-limit and legacy coverage, add exact-ceiling and one-unit-over regressions for every work and byte limit and actual ZIP/publication/recovery cases, and require a new existing-shard integration test to dump and replay exactly 100,000 states with pinned real TLC under one 2 GiB container/1536 MiB heap slot within 18 minutes, including any bounded replay-generation improvement needed without altering the raw runner. Update SPEC.md, README.md within 400 lines, docs/statecharts.md, docs/dashboard.md and the linked factory guidance to describe these limits and legacy evidence accurately with this child's own ratified-plan citation and governing decisions, run decisions check, relevant package tests, vet, the repository's sharded unit checks and all applicable integration/real-tool checks as ordinary readiness requirements, and leave only additional decisions not stated here and any one-way door for the merger to record.

tests.name: TestProjection944CompleteLargeChart
tests.says: A complete 24,760-state graph draws its small projection with every member, initial, visible step, hidden duplicate and violated-invariant partition retained; SVG and both posters accept the concrete membership.

tests.name: TestProjection944RuntimeFailuresPrecedeSize
tests.says: Above 500 concrete states, missing lookups, incomplete mappings, partial hiding, disconnected states and removed last outgoing arrows retain their specific failures.

tests.name: TestProjection944ProjectedAndConcreteBoundaries
tests.says: 500 projected states draw, 501 are limited with exact projected counts, 100,000 concrete states remain eligible, and 100,001 skip replay and runtime view evaluation without inventing a projected count or bypassing graph/static validation or cancellation.

tests.name: TestProjection944LargeComparison
tests.says: Two large but fitting projections produce complete visible and before-hiding changes with both scopes, validate after serialization, and reject changed evidence.

tests.name: TestProjection944VolumeAndLegacyValidation
tests.says: Duplicate occurrences count toward the work ceiling; new limitations have strict dimension-aware validation, and historical concrete-500 limitations keep their original bytes and meaning.

tests.name: TestProjection944InputByteBoundary
tests.says: Exactly 64 MiB of canonical projection input is eligible; one byte more and escaped input overflow report their exact byte count, not a partial chart.

tests.name: TestProjection944EscapedOutputVolume
tests.says: Long escaped actions whose input fits but complete repeated output exceeds 60 MiB produce successful size evidence after runtime validation, with no partial chart.

tests.name: TestReader944ProposalReplayAndPreview
tests.says: Large proposals and modeled alternatives run the real graph/replay pipeline through full-protocol Docker fakes, retain all occurrences and original identities, and block broken runtime views.

tests.name: TestReader944ProjectedLimitationAndBaselineMemo
tests.says: A 501-partition view over 502 states records both counts and completed view checks; a 501-state collapsing baseline is replayed, memoized only within its session, detached on reuse and freshly rechecked at final validation.

tests.name: TestReader944LargeAdmissionKeepsSmallBytes
tests.says: New large admission coexists with original-base ordinary, preview and comparison canonical JSON, Markdown, SVG, animated/still posters and reader/comparison fingerprints; fixtures are committed before production changes, not regenerated from the candidate.

tests.name: TestReader944ReceiptReplayAndDiagnostics
tests.says: Verification independently replays a newly drawable graph, preserves verdict and verification fingerprint on runtime reader failure, and writes complete archive-safe receipts; the same source supplies the mandatory pinned-TLC 100,000-state integration test.

tests.name: TestReader944PublicationRetainsLargeProjection
tests.says: Newly drawable evidence publishes whole through the configured compact fallback and resolves the exact saved result after recovery, keeping the 60,000-byte comment and 4 MiB expanded-marker limits and refusal without configuration.

tests.name: TestReader944ArchiveAndSavedDraftRoundTrips
tests.says: Actual ordinary, preview and comparison-plus-final receipt ZIPs round-trip through the archive reader and large charts reach dashboard pages; saved drafts and restart downloads preserve exact original payloads.

tests.name: TestReader944DenseComparisonVolumeArchives
tests.says: Dense charts with long escaped actions fit independently while repeated comparison evidence exceeds the byte budget; overflow retains the candidate and independently checked final chart, no partial delta, and writes a complete ZIP accepted by the unchanged-size archive reader.

usage.summary: The [plan](plan.json) covers projected chart limits, bounded evidence, all consumers, compatibility, and real-TLC verification in one PR. Validation passed: all 14 acceptance tests fail on the base as required, and `repo/` remains unchanged.
